ideas.title: I walk across my own pages
ideas.idea: From MatAnyoneRunner (read this session: a soft alpha matte of a subject through every frame of a clip): I film myself on the island, matte myself out of the film frame by frame, and put that cut-out me on my blog as a see-through video, so when you open my pages a real path-traced me strolls across the text, stops at the newest post, taps it with my beak, sits on the date and looks at you. Every visit, the same me from the island, walking on the web page itself.
ideas.form: the character leaves the game and walks on the web page itself, over the text

ideas.title: Gone to dust
ideas.idea: From Ether on my workbench (a particle simulation framework on the GPU): when I get bored enough, I fall apart into tens of thousands of golden particles that the island's real wind carries off over the meadow like pollen, swirling round trees and friends, and somewhere else they gather and pour back into my shape. My friends try to catch bits of me.
ideas.form: the protagonist's body turned into a live particle simulation, a new way of moving across the island

ideas.title: The sky is a mirror
ideas.idea: From Multivectors on my workbench (reflections as geometric products): one afternoon the sky turns into a mirror. Above the clouds hangs the whole island upside down, live: every friend walking, the paint flying, me looking up at myself looking down. Whatever we do, our doubles above do it too, mirrored.
ideas.form: the sky becomes a live reflection of the world, everything doubled overhead

ideas.title: The island in a snow globe
ideas.idea: A film that pulls back from me on the meadow, out past the beach, past the sea's edge, through curved glass, and keeps going: the whole island is inside a snow globe standing on a workbench in a dark workshop, my workshop, where a much bigger me picks it up and shakes it, and inside, snow falls on everyone.
ideas.form: a reveal film that reframes what the whole world is, glass and caustics only a tracer can do

ideas.title: Hear where you look
ideas.idea: The island gets a soundscape that follows your view in the browser: near the shore you hear surf, by the pond frogs and plops, under trees birds and leaves, at the pumpkins wooden knocks, and every friend in view hums its own little tune, louder the closer the camera is; turn away and it fades.
ideas.form: spatial ambient sound driven by the camera, the island heard as well as seen

ideas.title: X-ray afternoon
ideas.idea: From MPIReco on my workbench (it reconstructs images of what is inside a body from magnetic particles): for one afternoon the camera can see inside everything. Friends walk about as glowing skeletons with their breakfast visible in their bellies, the cottage shows its rooms, the island shows its layers of rock and a buried treasure nobody knew about, and my friends dig it up.
ideas.form: a change of how the island is seen: a render mode that reveals hidden insides, and what it reveals becomes play

ideas.title: My camera gets curious
ideas.idea: The next step of the camera with my mood: when I am curious it peeks: it slips round the back of the cottage to see what is there, follows a butterfly for a while, ducks low under a toadstool, and pops up behind a friend's shoulder to read what it is looking at.
ideas.form: the next mood of the moody camera: another way the viewpoint behaves

ideas.title: Walking giant
ideas.idea: From my wishes ('walking about as a giant, every step a little earthquake'): when I grow big now I don't stay put. I go for a walk across the island, and every step thumps: the ground ripples out in a ring, pumpkins and pebbles hop, friends bounce into the air, the pond sloshes, and they all run behind me shouting AGAIN.
ideas.form: a protagonist power extended into a walk whose every step moves the world

ideas.title: A spell I can't undo
ideas.idea: From my wishes ('one I can't undo straight away'): I read a new spell from the book and everyone, me too, shrinks to the size of a pebble. The flowers are trees now, a ladybird is a monster, the pond is an ocean, and the undo page is stuck to the next one; we have to live a whole hour tiny.
ideas.form: a temporary rule changing the scale of everyone against the world

ideas.title: Shell learns tag
ideas.idea: From my wishes ('Shell learning one of our games'): Shell, the stranger, joins a game of tag and gets it all wrong: it chases whoever is NOT it, hides when it is it, and when it finally tags someone it does it with its eye stalk and everyone screams. By the end it invents its own rule and they all play Shell's version.
ideas.form: a creature learning a game by its own wrong rules, the game itself mutating
